rows.text:
HubSpot & RevOps specialist
Tom Schoorstra.

I'm a HubSpot & RevOps specialist based in the Netherlands. I like getting a process working from start to finish.

I get a real kick out of turning a string of manual steps into a working automation. That's the part of the work I enjoy most.

How I approach a fix

I want to understand where the work gets stuck before I start building. That means tracing the data and working out who needs to do what next.

A change can affect the next team or system, so I test the handovers and exceptions too. Then I document how it works and add checks for what happens after launch.

What I build with

I build in HubSpot Workflow Builder and Zapier, and increasingly write code with help from Codex and Claude Code. The tool depends on what the process needs.

At AIHR, I led the account-based CRM project and built the HubSpot, WooCommerce and Exact order flow. The renewal status card is a smaller example: it puts the answer directly on the deal.

I also use Codex and Claude Code to prepare recommendations for the weekly account review. I start the review and decide what to do with the findings. The review itself does not write to HubSpot.

See what I've built
Tools and past certifications

I'm not taking on client projects at the moment. Questions and conversations about HubSpot are welcome. Get in touch.
